Cosmetic damage with no functional loss and ordinary wear are excluded. A technician-confirmed sudden functional failure or accidental impact of the named kind can qualify, subject to all other conditions. Repair and replacement are alternative bases, not cumulative payments; the stated eligible loss already uses the approved basis. Do not add accessory costs that are not part of that loss.
